limitations: corpus is the imported v1 text corpus, not freshly extracted v2 documents; extractor quality is out of scope for this run
queries are the fixed real-content suite (plain user text); v2 sanitizes FTS operators, so prefix/phrase categories are not equivalent to the legacy FTS syntax
